# Single-System Assessment — Synology NAS (Run Card)

## 1. When to use

- NAS health check during onboarding
- Quarterly storage capacity review
- "How full is the NAS / when do we need to expand?"
- Disk warranty/health audit before refresh
- Security review: unnecessary services enabled? Default admin account active?

Personas: NOC (disk/service health), TAM (capacity planning, user audit), vCIO/AM (refresh roadmap).

## 4. Report

Sections, in order: Executive Summary; System Overview; Disk Health; Storage Capacity (Volumes & Pools); Shared Folders; User Accounts; Network Configuration; Enabled Services; Installed Packages; Recommended Actions; Data Gaps & Coverage Notes.

Thresholds: inspector_lastseen_days_max=7; disk_temp_warn_celsius=50; volume_space_used_pct_warn=85; firmware_age_days_warn=180; user_expired_warn=True; services_to_flag_if_enabled=['Telnet', 'NFS', 'AFP'].

Report each metric's actual value. Show "No data" for empty values; never mark a control passing without a supporting value. A "No data" row is a coverage gap only if the control matters and no other row covers it.

Coverage table: metrics fetched / required, with data / no data counts. Internal audience: add a verification log, one row per call (seq, metricId, result shape, status).

### Insights and recommendations

| Insight | Trigger | Recommended action |
|---|---|---|
| Firmware outdated | `firmware_date` > 180 days old | "DSM firmware last updated <date> — check for updates." |
| Temperature warning | `sys_tempwarn EQ_OP true` OR `sys_temp > 50°C` | "NAS temperature at <N>°C — check airflow and fan health." |
| Disk degraded | `status != 'normal'` | "<N> disks in non-normal state — schedule replacement." |
| SSD life low | `remain_life.trustable EQ_OP true AND remain_life.value < 20` | "SSD <name> at <N>% remaining life — plan replacement." |
| Pool at risk | `disk_failure_number EQ_OP 0` | "Storage pool cannot tolerate additional disk failure — replace degraded disk immediately." |
| Volume high utilization | `size.used / size.total > 0.85` | "Volume at <N>% capacity — plan expansion." |
| Unencrypted volumes | `is_encrypted EQ_OP false` | "Volume(s) not encrypted — enable DSM volume encryption for data at rest." |
| Expired user accounts | `expired EQ_OP 'now'` | "<N> expired user accounts — disable or remove." |
| Default admin active | `name EQ_OP 'admin'` in Users | "Default 'admin' account active — rename per Synology security hardening guidance." |
| NAS using DHCP | `use_dhcp EQ_OP true` on active interface | "NAS IP assigned via DHCP — configure static IP for reliable network share access." |
| Telnet enabled | `display_name EQ_OP 'Telnet'` in enabled services | "Telnet is enabled — disable immediately; use SSH instead." |
| Legacy AFP enabled | AFP in enabled services | "AFP (Apple Filing Protocol) is enabled — disable if no macOS clients require it." |
| Packages not auto-updating | `autoupdate_r EQ_OP 'false'` | "<N> packages have auto-update disabled — schedule manual review." |
| Broken package | `status EQ_OP 'broken'` | "Package <name> is in broken state — reinstall." |
